title: Sign out only on this device
summary: Keep other saved sessions active when signing out of the current browser or installed app.
changes: Signing out now clears only the current browser or installed app session instead of revoking saved sessions on every device.
Realtime and background refresh work are still stopped before the local session is cleared.
Roster calculations, staffing, allocations, Pager, Reliever, the interface, service-worker behaviour and database rules remain unchanged.
